facts.fact: 五十英里撞开铁丝网门——挡风玻璃蛛网裂纹。
facts.anchor: She smashed through them at fifty miles an hour

facts.fact: 保时捷后座两个孩子还绑着安全带——头歪向一侧；在呼吸（睡着、被下药？）。
facts.anchor: seeing two children in the back, still strapped in, heads lolled to the side.

facts.fact: Alex 连环自责：没顶住 Keller、没接受 Harper 提议、没让他们进房、没打给 Tom。
facts.anchor: Alex cursed herself bloody for not standing up to Keller

facts.fact: 挂锁三枪：第一枪偏、第二枪中、第三枪打断锁鼻。
facts.anchor: missed it the first time, fired again, struck true, dented it, the third, striking the corner

facts.fact: 屋内装置：顶棚电缆滑轮吊椅——椅腿朝天、椅背入水「和之前的一样」。
facts.anchor: a series of cables and pulleys attached to a chair that was lowered backward into the water like the others

facts.fact: Alex 跪在冷混凝土上——太迟了；Claire Harper 死了。
facts.anchor: Alex sank to her knees on the cold concrete floor, knowing that it was too late.
